description: The style library: a creator's saved looks. A look is an arrangement of blocks (a layout, what sits in it, the captions over it) started from a library template. The server runs these inside a Chirpy turn through the same operations a connector calls.

actions.description: Save a new look for the creator, started from a library template (from is its id, such as half-and-half) or copied from one of their saved looks (from is the look's id). The source is not changed.

Change a saved look: rename it, or apply up to 8 edits in order, all or nothing. Each edit names a place (layout, layout.top, captions): setOptions changes the look of the block there, setContent changes what it shows, setBlock swaps it for another style, clear empties it.
Delete one of the creator's saved looks. The creator is asked to confirm first.

from.description: A library template id or the id of one of the creator's looks.

at.description: The place to change, as listed for the look: layout, layout.top, overlay, captions.

styleId.description: For setBlock: the style to put there, such as splits.speaker-below.

options.description: Option keys and values for the block, from its listed settings. Out-of-range numbers are clamped and unknown keys dropped, and the receipt says so.

content.description: What the block shows: a picture or clip URL, a label, a value.
